description: This file defines the RecruitmentAttachmentService class within the OrangeHRM recruitment plugin, which manages recruitment attachment operations. It includes a constant for allowed file types and a method to retrieve the associated data access object.

classes.name: RecruitmentAttachmentService
classes.description: Service class for managing recruitment attachment data; provides access to the DAO and defines allowed file types.

methods.name: getRecruitmentAttachmentDao
methods.description: Returns the DAO object responsible for recruitment attachment database interactions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of RecruitmentAttachmentService, creating the DAO object.
